caption:
Teams is where a plan becomes tickets with names on them. Every ticket moves through New, In Progress, Client Review and Closed. Roles are separated into Owner, Analyst, Consultant and Viewer, and nothing reaches a client until someone signs it off. The today view shows what is open, overdue, awaiting approval and closed this week. It is how one business keeps track of what is moving and what has quietly stopped.

Diagnose your #1 constraint free. Link in bio.
first_comment: What is sitting in your team right now that nobody has picked up?
